card.name: Second part of compound terms
card.fires_on: The second piece of a multi-word term, such as 'dose' in 'flexible-dose' or 'Base' in 'Sovereign Base Area'. It responds just before the term's last word or phrase is completed.

modes.label: Flexible-dose
modes.description: The word 'dose' or 'ose' after 'flexible' in clinical trial descriptions.
modes.example: Includes patients treated with flexible<< dose>> of asenapine 5 or

modes.label: Named place or project terms
modes.description: A middle word in a proper name or title, such as Base in Sovereign Base Area or the end of Multi-Purpose.
modes.example: Akrotiri (āˌkrōtēˈrē) [key], Akrotiri Sovereign<< Base>> Area, or Western Sovereign Base Area
